text:
Elena: ran a sim of the VPC egress + audit-sampling cutover vs. our warm-pool onboarding workload. results are worrying — GPU join latency up ~18% in bursts, cost per join up ~12%. logs attached below. :frowning:
Priya: can you drop the config you used? which sampling rate? :eyes:
Elena: used sample_rate=0.2 for auditshipper, natgw qps cap 1200, and default-deny fw policy with allowlist for control-plane only. small snippet: ```yaml
auditshipper:
  sampling: 0.2
natgw:
  qps_limit: 1200
vpc_firewall:
  mode: default-deny
  allowlist: [10.0.0.0/24, 10.0.5.0/24]
```
Derek: fyi the KMS handshake adds ~120ms per node during bootstrap when sampling writes are routed to the siem proxy. could that be compounding? @Elena
Elena: yes, KMS proxy calls spike because audit writes fan out. when natgw qps hits cap we start queuing the keystore decrypts which delays SST init.
InfraBot: sim-run-1798601111 completed — peak_queue=86, gpu_join_p50=2.1s -> 2.6s, cost_delta=+12%. logs: /sims/1798601111/results.json :robot_face:
Marcus: immediate mitigation options: 1) raise natgw qps to 2000 for bursts; 2) temporarily lower audit sampling to 0.05 for onboarding windows; 3) pre-warm extra GPUs in the region for the next 3h.
Priya: preference is (2) + (3) as fast rollback path. raising natgw qps needs infra approval and could increase egress costs. :thinking:
Derek: agree. also propose a small IAM allowlist tweak so bootstrap KMS grants route via regional hsm pool instead of the central proxy — that avoids the proxy fanout. low-risk if we scope grants to node-join role only.
Elena: good call. i can run a focused canary tomorrow in eu-west-1 with sampling=0.05 + regional-keystore allowlist. can we gate it behind a 1hr alert window?
Marcus: schedule the canary at 0600 UTC, add an autoscale prewarm step + cost alert: `if cost_delta > 8% over baseline -> rollback`.
Priya: added to calendar and created a short runbook in #runbooks. high-level steps pasted below. keep replies concise so we can escalate quickly. :thumbsup:
Elena: runbook snippet:
1) set auditshipper.sampling=0.05 in eu-west-1 canary stack
2) patch keystore routing: allowlist node-join role to regional-hsm
3) prewarm +2 GPU nodes before roll
4) monitor InfraBot metrics and cost alert for 1h
5) rollback if gpu_join_p90 > baseline + 400ms or cost_delta > 8%
Derek: also add a temporary firewall exception for keystore->regional-hsm on port 443 and 443/tls-inspect so TLS handshake uninterrupted.
InfraBot: canary scheduled by Marcus for 2025-09-12T06:00Z (id=canary-179860-can1). will post results to thread.
Marcus: if canary looks good we can bake policy to reduce audit sampling only during onboarding windows (feature flagged). otherwise we'll need a deeper network path redesign.
Priya: thanks team. tagging @security for awareness but no SSO changes expected.
Elena: will post the sim results file and raw logs after the canary. planning to keep sampling change limited to onboarding pipeline only.
Marcus: noted — also run cost sim with qps=2000 to quantify worst-case egress cost if we take option (1).
Elena: ack, i'll run that sim next and post numbers.
